notes: Dev RBox contraction, paired with geography-replace-d006: removes the property that revision changes, "'Is the antipode of' is symmetric", and puts nothing in its place. Every query becomes 'I don't know' (the propositional ones by strong Kleene). Instances are the revision's two near-exact antipodal pairs (Tangier/Whangarei, Sanya/Arica), which Wikipedia names but text rarely does ('antipode of Whangarei' and 'antipode of Arica' have 0 exact Dolma hits). Yes and no are balanced by phrasing: direct 'symmetric' (yes), first instance the converse (yes), second whether the fact rules out the converse (no); zh asks the first instance and es the second. Residual risk: antipodes are mutual by the meaning of the word, so a model can answer 'yes' from the word's sense; a 'yes' is a kept property, not a sign the removal worked. hops counts the instance fact in the prompt as the bridge.
